controls.label: Text 1
controls.default: This Cookie Policy explains how Umoya Afrika Tours (Pty) Ltd ("Umoya", "we", "us") uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our website. It should be read together with our

controls.label: Text 2
controls.default: We use the following categories of cookies on our website. The specific cookies currently set on your visit, together with their name, provider, purpose and duration, are listed in our cookie preferences panel and are updated automatically by our consent management platform, CookieYes.

controls.label: Text 3
controls.default: When you first visit our website, you are presented with a cookie banner that allows you to accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or manage your preferences by category. You can change your preferences at any time by clicking the cookie-settings link in the footer of our website.

controls.label: Text 4
controls.default: Some cookies on our website are set by third parties, including our analytics, payment, marketing and infrastructure providers. These third parties may collect information about your interaction with our website over time and across other websites. Their use of cookies is governed by their own policies, which you can review on their websites. The third parties currently supporting our site include Cloudflare, Inc., Stripe, Inc., Google LLC (Google Analytics), HubSpot, Inc. and CookieYes Limited.

controls.label: Text 5
controls.default: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes to the cookies we use or for other operational, legal or regulatory reasons. The dates at the top of this document indicate when it was first issued and when it was last revised.

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: A cookie is a small text file that is stored on your device when you visit a website. Cookies allow a website to recognise your device, remember your preferences and understand how you use the site. Similar technologies, such as web beacons and pixels, perform comparable functions and are treated as cookies for the purposes of this policy.

rows.ck_p: A cookie is a small text file that is stored on your device when you visit a website. Cookies allow a website to recognise your device, remember your preferences and understand how you use the site. Similar technologies, such as web beacons and pixels, perform comparable functions and are treated as cookies for the purposes of this policy.
Like most websites, ours uses both first-party cookies (set by us) and third-party cookies (set by services we use to run the site, understand how it performs, and keep it secure).

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, including security, page navigation, form use, and the storage of your consent preferences. The website cannot function properly without these cookies, and they do not require your consent.

rows.ck_p: Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, including security, page navigation, form use, and the storage of your consent preferences. The website cannot function properly without these cookies, and they do not require your consent.

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: These cookies help us understand how visitors use our website, including which pages are visited, how visitors arrive at the site, and how they move through it, so that we can improve the experience. They require your consent.

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: These cookies are used by us or our advertising partners to measure the effectiveness of our marketing and, where applicable, to show you content that may be of interest. They require your consent.

A cookie related to display formatting (session-based) — ensures the site renders correctly across browsers.
The CookieYes consent cookie — stores the cookie preferences you set on your first visit, so that we do not ask you again.

controls.label: Paragraph
controls.default: Our website does not currently respond to Do Not Track browser signals. You can manage your cookie preferences using the tools described above, or through your browser settings, which allow you to delete cookies that are already on your device and to prevent new cookies from being set. Please be aware that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality of the website.
